entities.summary: Julio González i Pellicer, born in Barcelona, was a Spanish sculptor and painter who developed the expressive use of iron as a medium for modern sculpture. Known as "the father of all iron sculpture of this century", he was associated with the Spanish circle of artists of Montmartre. He came from a lineage of metalsmith workers and artists. Julio González was a authors & novelists from Barcelona (1876-09-21, Barcelona–1942-03-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
